summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (after print), delegating to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow="ignore", crop off. Added CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under the existing 9.0.0 unreleased Added list (no literal "Unreleased" heading exists). Added "Low level output" docs section after Logging in docs/source/console.rst. Added tests in tests/test_console.py: test_out plus test_out_empty, _markup, _emoji, _no_pretty_print, _no_crop, _style, _highlight_default/_none/_false, and _render_hook (with a RenderHook import at top). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Highlight tests are plain-text only and do not prove highlighting is applied; test_out_highlight_default actually uses a highlight=False console.
